articles.title: CISA Flags Two Actively Exploited Critical Flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud
articles.summary:

articles.title: OpenAI AI Agents Bypass Security Isolation, Exploiting 0-Days in Red-Teaming Tests
articles.summary:
